about: Every design mock-up, by section, for the gallery at /mockups/ (design/index.html). Add a card here whenever a new mock-up folder lands in design/; `node scripts/mockup-gallery.mjs` refreshes the thumbnails and fails if a folder is missing from this list. Optional `shot`: the address the gallery picture is taken from, when the mock-up's difference is not on its first page.

cards.title: David · Two voices
cards.line: The record and David's psalms in counterpoint, joined by harp strings that vibrate as each moment arrives (only psalms whose title names the moment).

cards.title: David · The house of David
cards.line: Saul's and David's houses as a living tree with a year scrubber: sons appear, branches grey at each death, crowns pass; 1 Kings 1 as a drama.

cards.title: David · War table

cards.title: David · Life helix
cards.line: A WebGL double helix of his 70 years: Samuel–Kings in gold, Chronicles in silver, rungs where they differ, 46 event crystals; drag to turn.

cards.title: A · The road
cards.line: Recommended. The map is the page: a full-width journey map stays in place while you scroll, the route draws itself act by act, and each scene rises over it as a glass panel.

cards.title: B · Three forties
cards.line: A command-deck hero: a 120-year ring split into the three forties; choose an act and its bento tiles (scenes, people, words, places) fill the screen and open in place.

cards.title: C · Cinema
cards.line: Full-screen chapters, each with a large line drawing (bush, sea, mountain, tent, Nebo); scenes slide sideways within a chapter; the full text waits in drawers.

cards.title: D · Constellation
cards.line: Moses at the centre of a field: rings of people, places, moments and words, clockwise in story order; choose any point and its panel opens beside it, lines drawn to everything it touches.

cards.title: E · Face to face
cards.line: His life told only through the conversations Scripture records: voices as presences (the LORD as light, never a figure), a score of every line, ten places, threads to follow; every word quoted from the KJV.

cards.title: F · In his hands
cards.line: A specimen cabinet of the eleven objects Scripture names in his life, each drawn by hand: open a case for every verse about it, follow each through time, and see the one object Scripture measures to scale.

cards.title: G · The long memory
cards.line: All 786 verses that name him as light across the 66 books: Exodus to Deuteronomy blaze, then the echoes to Revelation; sort by how a verse remembers him or who is speaking, only where the words support it.

cards.title: H · The merged page
cards.line: Newest, second pass. B's three-forties landing as it was; the whole road on one quiet Atlas map with a way into the Atlas; three dense chapters (Egypt, Midian, the wilderness), each with a sky of faint dots, a giant numeral, sideways scenes, every event with its verse, the people, signs, words and world stage in typographic columns, and a line-art landscape for ground; the map slides in beside a chapter and back out; then the man and his family tree, the word, the constellation of the people around him, the questions as floating words, and C's dot navigation down the side.

cards.title: Tribes A · The land
cards.line: A full-screen map: every tribe a constellation of the towns Joshua gives it (Atlas points, no drawn borders), and a history scrubber: allotment, Dan moves north, the kingdom divided, the north carried away, Ezekiel's bands.

cards.title: Tribes B · The camp
cards.line: The tabernacle with the twelve camped round it (Numbers 2), each block a field of dots, one per thousand; toggle Numbers 1 and 26 and watch Simeon shrink; Break camp plays the march of Numbers 10.

cards.title: Tribes C · The family
cards.line: Four mothers as lanes, twelve sons born one by one with the words said at each naming; ribbons cross to the tribes, drawn as wide as the people our data places in each.

cards.title: Tribes D · The ledger
cards.line: Recommended: it draws the brief's own insight. Twenty-five lists as a score, one row per list; Braid turns each tribe into a thread through them; the two blessings as a duet; a fingerprint card per tribe. Keep A's constellation map for the land section.

cards.title: Apostles · The merged page
cards.line: The merged apostle page: a full-screen landing drawn for each of the fourteen (switch at the top right, in the order of Matthew 10, then Matthias and Paul), the record ring, the chapter grid, four cinema chapters in the Moses containers, who was with him (lines or the whole circle), one moment in several accounts each in its own card, his places as cards beside an Atlas-style map that stays on his places, and every open question from the reviewed sources as floating words.

cards.title: Apostles · A · Lifeline
cards.line: Round 3, in the Authors house style (Peter; Paul and Thaddaeus by ?who=). A plain hero with four figures; the life ring in Scripture's four parts; who was with him, every record in story order with each companion as a line that lights where a verse names them together; did their paths cross (Peter and Paul, with the verses); the mission on a NASA Blue Marble globe; questions as floating words.

cards.title: Apostles · B · Chapters
cards.line: The owner's ideal page for an apostle: the life ring as header, a looping line-art scene (the boat and the net; the road and the light; the list of the Twelve), four cinema chapters with giant numerals and faint stars, "See the map" sliding the globe in beside each chapter, the cabinet of things Scripture names, and a second page with everyone on one sky.

cards.title: Apostles · C · Side by side
cards.line: The Preached Bible way: a heat grid of every chapter that names him, one moment told by each Gospel in its own KJV words as quiet columns, crystals by kind of moment, the places as a sideways row of large tiles, the globe for the mission, questions as floating words.

cards.title: E · The score
cards.line: Set aside 2026-10-08: arcade look; the globe kept. Round 2, the apostle page (Peter; Paul and Thaddaeus by ?who=). His life as a score: Matthew, Mark, Luke, John, Acts and the letters are staves, every event a note in the harmony's order; drag the playhead or press play and the scene opens above.

cards.title: F · The globe
cards.line: Set aside 2026-10-08: arcade look; the globe kept. A turning 3D globe of the Roman world: Scripture's journeys as solid arcs, tradition's routes dashed and labelled with who said it and when; scroll and the globe turns to each place, the scene rising beside it.

cards.title: G · The thread
cards.line: Set aside 2026-10-08: arcade look; the globe kept. Every recorded exchange as a message history, word for word from the KJV with its verse: Jesus in red letters, the apostle on the right; Gospel tabs where the wording differs, tradition as forwarded reports, open questions as polls with no votes.

cards.title: H · The strata
cards.line: Set aside 2026-10-08: arcade look; the globe kept. The evidence as the picture: four glass plates stacked in 3D, Scripture at the bottom, then early church, later tradition and scholars, each carrying its claims on one life-line; drag to tilt, explode, and drill a core through every layer.

cards.title: Unseen A · The veil
cards.line: Michael, angels and demons page (/people/:id/unseen). Two realms on one screen: Daniel's three weeks of mourning by the river below, the unseen above as a plain diagram of what Daniel 10 says (who withstood, for how many days, who came to help); scrolling lifts a woven veil between them.

cards.title: Unseen B · War in heaven
cards.line: Michael. Revelation 12 as a night-sky chart in fine line: the woman clothed with the sun, the dragon as a figure of stars with seven crowned heads, Michael and his angels as points of light; each verse lights its part, and on a phone the view follows it.

cards.title: Unseen C · Strata
cards.line: Michael. The evidence as a flat geological section: Scripture as bedrock, then Jewish writings outside the Bible, early church, later tradition and scholars, each layer dated; a drill core goes down and every find opens beside it. Close in idea to the apostle set's glass-plate strata.

cards.title: Unseen D · Who is like God?
cards.line: Recommended. Michael. The name as the centrepiece (מִיכָאֵל in its three parts, with the lexicons' meaning), then the whole Bible as one spine to scale with a light wherever he is named: the planned 'where they appear' picture, and it works for every being in scope. War in heaven's line drawing can serve its visions.

cards.line: Recommended. Seven small tinted cards, one colour per kind, choose one; its lines in two columns. The shortest page, and the coloured cards stand out the most. Crisis lines keep their call/text buttons on the closed row in all four directions.

cards.title: Hero drawing · twenty-four to choose from
cards.line: Twenty-four slowly looping line drawings for the top of the page, in three grids of eight, each with its King James verse: still waters, the shepherd of Isaiah 40, a lamp, wings over a nest, an open door, a lighthouse on the rock, morning, a mended plant, then a boat on a calm sea, a well, loaves and fishes, an anchor, a vine, a valley path, the dove with the olive leaf, an eagle, then a mustard tree with birds, a tent under the stars, a rainbow, sheaves, lilies of the field, a tree by the river, a window in the rain and a city on a hill. Say the number to choose.

sections.title: Study · New theology studies
sections.line: New Scripture & Theology studies, built from the written drafts.

cards.title: Faith in daily life
cards.line: Six everyday places in the letters, read in the Berean under the Baptist Faith and Message. Its new move: ask the sentence why, each instruction's own reason sorted toward the Lord or toward another person.

cards.title: Faith under pressure
cards.line: Six pressures in the letters, read in the Berean under the Baptist Faith and Message. Its new move: name the pressure, find the ground, every verse laid out with what it names, what it calls for and what it stands on.

cards.title: Faith under pressure: the wall
cards.line: A dry-stone wall where every stone is a verse, as long as the verse is. Six piers take six different loads: arrows of many kinds, a door in the wall, a load cast off, words thrown from one side, one stone missing with a small light in its place, a prop of other people's help.

cards.title: Covenants and promises
cards.line: Five covenants and how the letters read them, in the Berean under the Baptist Faith and Message. Its new move: ask every promise the same five questions, then see the whole Bible as one line with arcs to the verses that come back to it.

cards.title: Covenants and promises: the signs
cards.line: The same study, wholly different. Each covenant is a full-width world and its sign holds the five questions: a bow, stars, stone, a crown, a cup. The later verses ripple across a disc of the whole Bible, and the signs move into each map.

cards.title: The hope to come
cards.line: Christ's return, the resurrection, the judgment and the new creation, in the Berean under the Baptist Faith and Message. Its new move: three questions for any passage about the end, then four orders of events lined up on the return, without choosing.

cards.title: The hope to come: the horizon
cards.line: The same study, wholly different. One land seen from one place: sky is what is promised, haze what it leaves open, ground what it asks now. Six readings, one at a time, each with its own drawn view; what was lost and answered on facing pages from dusk to dawn; four orders of events on one chart, lined up on the return.
